meta.title: Roam Timeframe Table — Enhanced
meta.based_on: Original timeframe JSON (5 roam archetypes, 0:00-18:00) + online verification for Season 42
meta.how_to_use: Each role has steps aligned to real objective spawns. Use startSeconds/endSeconds for your in-game timer UI. Check 'objective' and 'checklist' for what to do, 'decision' for engage vs disengage, and 'dont' for the most common throw in that window. In solo queue, prioritize the checklist over forcing a fight — if your team is not in position, take vision + trade instead.

lithowanderer.note: River crab. Small team reward + short river benefit. Take it only if it does not delay Turtle setup.

turtle.reward: Team-wide gold + EXP + shield / buff for 120s (varies by Battlefield variant, e.g. Healing Turtle in Season 42 annual map change)
turtle.note: First Turtle is the highest-value early objective. Setup 20-30s early.

lord.note: Respawn ~3 min, shorter late. Evolves into Evolved Lord around 18:00 (1080s). Late Lords end games.

evolved_lord.note: Stronger Lord with charge. Never start it 50/50 — take it after a won fight or a pick.

outer_turret_shield.note: Outer turret energy shields drop at 5:00. After that, tower damage converts to real gold/pressure.

jungler_level_4.note: Standard full clear should hit Lv4 before Turtle. Roamer should NOT steal camps — your EXP comes from Roam passive + assists.

roam_mechanics.buy_first: Buy Roam boots (600 gold, +40 MS, +18 Magic Defense) at 0:00. Do NOT delay it for another item — you lose Thriving gold/EXP.
roam_mechanics.devotion: For the first 8 minutes, you get only 30% gold from a minion/creep you take with no ally nearby. Leave waves and camps to laners/jungler.
roam_mechanics.thriving: If you are the lowest-gold ally, you gain passive gold + EXP every 5s: ~6 gold + 12 EXP before 8:00, ~8 gold + 16 EXP after 8:00 (capped). This is your farm. Stay lowest-gold on purpose.
roam_mechanics.blessing_unlock: Blessing unlocks after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving (usually around 4-5 min). Conceal is the only active blessing; others are passive.
roam_mechanics.vision_rule: MLBB has no wards. You are the ward. Face-check with HP, never alone at low HP, and always check the bush your carry is about to walk into first.
roam_mechanics.five_second_rule: Revealing an enemy grants gold/EXP. After an enemy disappears, wait ~5s and re-reveal for another proc — don't spam face-checks with no value.
roam_mechanics.solo_queue_note: Solo queue teams often expect you to babysit the Marksman. Don't. Protect MM early, then follow the next fight. If your team won't group for Turtle/Lord, trade: take opposite buff, tower, or a safe pick instead of dying 1v4.

global_rules: Arrive 20-30s BEFORE Turtle/Lord spawns, not at spawn time.
Never start Lord with enemy jungler + Retribution alive and nearby.
Trade your life only for an objective or your carry's life.
Don't take last hits from carries — your income is assists + Thriving + reveals.
After a won fight, convert to tower or objective immediately. Don't chase into fog.
If you lose lanes, give up Turtle and take the opposite side (buff/tower) instead of forcing a losing fight.

compact_mode.goal: Widget must stay 2 rows tall in landscape. Collapsed shows callout only. Expanded shows full description, checklist, vision, decision, dont.
compact_mode.heroes_note: Heroes are pre-game only. Hide heroes in live view, show only when timer is 0 and expanded.
compact_mode.width_rule: Portrait 98% width, landscape 62% width so it does not cover the fight.

blessings.name: Conceal
blessings.effect: Conceals you + nearby allies and grants ~40% extra Movement Speed for 5s, or until you deal/take damage. Breaks on damage.
blessings.cooldown: Active cooldown ~60s (in-game). Use to start a coordinated fight or to disengage a losing one — not to walk into empty jungle.

blessings.name: Encourage
blessings.effect: Nearby allies (incl. self) gain +12 to +30 Physical Attack & Magic Power (scales with Thriving gold) and +15% Attack Speed. Recent rework also adds hybrid defense in team fights.

blessings.name: Favor
blessings.effect: Every 10s, your next heal/shield restores an extra 300-750 HP to the lowest-HP ally (incl. self) within range.

blessings.name: Dire Hit
blessings.effect: Every 30s, your damage to an enemy below 35% HP deals an extra ~12% of target's Max HP as hybrid damage. Finisher, not a poke tool.

roles.label: Engage Tank
roles.playstyle: Frontline initiator. You start fights, zone Turtle/Lord, and peel. Your ultimate is the team's engage button — don't waste it on a single low-value target.

heroes.name: Tigreal
heroes.note: Best with Conceal + Flicker. Classic Turtle/Lord engage.

heroes.name: Khufra
heroes.note: Top roam in S42 (54%+ WR). Ball form blocks dashes, great vs assassins.

heroes.name: Atlas
heroes.note: Conceal + Flicker + Ult can win Lord fights alone if follow-up is close.

heroes.name: Minotaur
heroes.note: S-tier sustain tank in S42. Rage management = engage timing.

heroes.name: Lolita
heroes.note: Strong vs marksman/mage comps. Shield blocks poke before objective.

heroes.name: Johnson
heroes.note: Drive to create numbers advantage. Don't drive alone into 5.

heroes.name: Hylos
heroes.note: Tanky zone + slow. Good when team needs a wall, not a flash engage.

heroes.name: Grock
heroes.note: Level 1 wall can steal buff / block Turtle pit. Falls off if you force bad fights.

heroes.name: Baxia
heroes.note: Anti-heal passive counters sustain comps (Estes/Rafaela/Floryn).

heroes.name: Gloo
heroes.note: Ult-split to stick to carry. Good for zoning backline at Lord.

heroes.name: Edith
heroes.note: Can flex EXP. As roam, use Ult to frontline after engage.

heroes.name: Akai
heroes.note: Ult pin into wall at Turtle/Lord = free Retribution window.

heroes.name: Belerick
heroes.note: S-tier in S42. Punishes AoE / multi-hit comps, strong vs MM.

heroes.name: Gatotkaca
heroes.note: Taunt + Ult for multi-man engage. Save taunt for diver peel.

heroes.name: Kalea
heroes.note: Buffed in 2.2.16a. Heal + CC. Can roam or EXP — check draft.

battle_spells: Vengeance (vs burst / when you will be focused)
Petrify (second AoE stun if team lacks CC)
roles.emblem: Tank Emblem — Concussive Blast or Focusing Mark. Prioritize HP + Hybrid Defense + Tenacity.
strengths: Wins Turtle/Lord fights with one good engage
weaknesses: Useless if you engage without damage follow-up
Long cooldowns — if you miss Ult, disengage
roles.win_condition: Land a multi-man CC when your damage dealers are in range, then convert to Turtle/Lord/tower.
roles.lose_condition: Engaging alone, or using Conceal to walk into fog with no team behind you.

steps.description: Buy Roam boots immediately. Guard your jungler's starting buff from a safe angle. Do NOT donate first blood — spot the invade, don't fight it 1v3.
checklist: Stand in bush near jungler's buff
steps.vision: Bush at jungler's buff + river entrance
steps.decision: If enemy invades with 3+, give buff and trade opposite side.
steps.dont: Don't face-check enemy jungle alone at Lv1.
steps.compact: Setup - Guard buff, no feed

steps.objective: Help mid clear, link to jungler
steps.description: Help mid clear first wave, then move with jungler. Hold key CC — threaten counter-invade only with lane priority. Reveal enemies for Thriving gold.
steps.vision: Mid river bush + Gold-lane river bush
steps.decision: Engage only if mid + jungler can follow in 2s.
steps.dont: Don't stay in mid to farm.
steps.compact: Early Rotate - Help mid, link jungler

steps.description: Move to Turtle side 20-30s early. Sweep river bushes, keep an escape route. Your jungler should be Lv4 by ~1:40. Stand where enemy must walk through you to reach pit.
steps.vision: Turtle pit entrance + enemy jungle exit
steps.decision: If enemy has numbers, poke + delay — don't start Turtle 2v4.
steps.dont: Don't start Turtle without your jungler.
steps.compact: Turtle Setup - Setup Turtle early

steps.description: Be at Turtle BEFORE it spawns. Zone enemy approaches; engage only when damage dealers can follow. Your job is to let jungler Retribution safely — body-block the enemy jungler, don't hit Turtle.
checklist: Save Ult for enemy engage or Retribution denial
Peel if enemy dives your jungler
steps.decision: Engage if enemy jungler is isolated or uses Retribution early.
steps.dont: Don't chase a low-HP enemy while Turtle is up.
steps.compact: First Turtle - Zone pit, save Ult

steps.description: After objective, protect nearest carry and help mid regain priority. Use Turtle shield (120s) to trade aggressively but don't chase into fog. Rotate to Gold lane if MM is pressured.
checklist: Escort MM or mid back to lane
Check Gold-lane bush before MM walks in
steps.decision: If Turtle won: push tower. If lost: trade opposite buff/tower.
steps.dont: Don't stay in river alone after Turtle.
steps.compact: Post-Turtle - Protect carry, reset

steps.objective: Track Turtle respawn (~4:00) + turret shields end 5:00
steps.description: Second Turtle spawns ~2 min after first kill (~4:00). Start vision early and save Ult for contest. Outer turret shields drop at 5:00 — after that, tower damage matters more.
steps.decision: If enemy is ahead, give Turtle and take tower/buff trade.
steps.dont: Don't force second Turtle if your team is behind and split.
steps.compact: Second Turtle - 2nd Turtle, push after 5:00

steps.objective: Control river, prep for Lord at 8:00
steps.description: Third Turtle can spawn ~6:00 if previous was taken on time — check timer, don't guess. Escort team through river, keep frontline between enemies and carries. Blessing should be unlocked now (1000g Thriving) — Conceal is live.
checklist: Buy anti-heal if enemy sustains (Dominance Ice)
steps.decision: Use Conceal only when team is grouped and ready to fight.
steps.dont: Don't use Conceal to roam alone.
steps.compact: Mid Game / Third Turtle - Control river, prep Lord

steps.description: Lord spawns at 8:00. Prepare Lord-side vision early. Look for numbers advantage (pick or enemy dead) before starting. Stand at pit entrance while team hits Lord.
checklist: Force a pick before Lord if possible
Don't start Lord 50/50 vs alive enemy jungler
steps.decision: Start Lord only after won fight or enemy jungler dead/missing far.
steps.dont: Don't start Lord while your MM is clearing bot alone.
steps.compact: First Lord - Vision Lord, need numbers

steps.description: Lead safe rotations, check bushes before carries cross. Convert won fights into towers or next Lord. Group with Lord wave — don't split push alone as tank.
checklist: Check bush before team crosses river
steps.decision: Push if Lord alive + team grouped. Reset if Lord dead and enemy respawns.
steps.compact: Lord Push - Push with Lord

steps.description: Do not face-check alone. Hold one reliable CC to interrupt divers or punish committed enemy. Death timers are long — one pick can be Lord.
steps.decision: Engage if enemy diver commits and your carry is safe.
steps.dont: Don't chase a kill across map with Lord up.
steps.compact: Mid-Late - Hold CC, don't face-check

steps.objective: Peel + Conceal engage for Evolved Lord
steps.description: Stay close to peel main damage dealer. Use Conceal to start a coordinated fight or disengage a losing one. Evolved Lord (~18:00) ends games — never give it for free.
checklist: Buy Immortality / Winter Crown if ahead/behind
steps.vision: Evolved Lord pit — walk first, team close behind
steps.decision: Fight only with full team + Ult + Conceal ready.
steps.dont: Don't die alone scouting with no info gained.
steps.compact: Late / Evolved Lord - Peel carry, Conceal fight

roles.label: Pick-off Tank
roles.playstyle: Single-target catch. You live in bushes and fog. One hook/suppression = Turtle, Lord, or tower. If you miss, you reset — you don't force.

heroes.name: Franco
heroes.note: Hook is the win condition. Hide, don't show in lane. Flicker + Hook + Ult.

heroes.name: Kaja
heroes.note: Buffed in 2.2.16. Ult suppress pulls carry into team. Strong vs mobile heroes.

heroes.name: Jawhead
heroes.note: Throw enemy into team or throw ally to engage. Great for isolating jungler at Turtle.

heroes.name: Grock
heroes.note: Flex from Engage — wall + Ult can isolate one target at objective.

heroes.name: Saber
heroes.note: Solo-queue pick: Ult deletes one carry. Needs team to follow — don't pick if you have no frontline.

roles.emblem: Tank or Support — Focusing Mark to amplify team burst after catch. Move Speed + HP.
strengths: Best at denying enemy Retribution user
weaknesses: No teamfight if you miss catch
Squishier than engage tanks if you get collapsed
roles.win_condition: Catch the enemy jungler, mid, or MM before objective, then take objective 5v4.
roles.lose_condition: Forcing hooks when your burst ally is clearing wave or dead.

steps.objective: Identify enemy jungler start, avoid unsupported invade
steps.description: Buy Roam blessing. Identify enemy jungler's likely start (buff near their Gold lane). Avoid unsupported invade — spot, ping, retreat.
checklist: Check enemy buff bush from safe angle
steps.decision: Only invade if you have 3+ and enemy is spotted opposite side.
steps.dont: Don't hook Lv1 with no follow-up.
steps.compact: Setup - Spot jungler start

steps.objective: Threaten hook only with ally in range
steps.description: Rotate through mid and threaten hook/suppression only when ally is in range. Stay in fog — if enemy sees you, they won't walk up.
checklist: Stay in mid bush, not in lane
Wait for mid to be in burst range
steps.decision: Hook if ally can burst in 1s and you have escape.
steps.compact: Early Rotate - Hide, hook with ally

steps.objective: Mark enemy jungler/mid, keep catch ready
steps.description: Check Turtle-side river and mark enemy jungler or mid. Keep key catch skill ready — don't waste it on tank.
steps.decision: Catch if enemy jungler steps up alone.
steps.dont: Don't hook the tank to start Turtle.
steps.compact: Turtle Setup - Mark jungler, save hook

steps.description: At first Turtle, punish isolated targets and interrupt enemy Retribution user. Don't abandon jungler — your catch protects his Retribution.
checklist: Hook/suppress enemy jungler when Turtle low
Peel if enemy dives your jungler
steps.decision: Use Ult on jungler if Turtle < Retribution range.
steps.dont: Don't chase kill while Turtle is being stolen.
steps.compact: First Turtle - Hook jungler, deny Retri

steps.description: Move between mid and Gold. Create short ambushes from controlled bushes, then leave before collapsed on. One pick = tower or Turtle.
steps.decision: If no pick in 10s, rotate — don't camp empty bush.
steps.dont: Don't stay in one bush for 30s while team fights elsewhere.
steps.compact: Roam Pick - Short ambush, leave fast

steps.description: Use actual next Turtle spawn (~4:00) to time a pick. Caught enemy = objective window, not reason to chase farther.
steps.decision: If pick lands, take Turtle immediately.
steps.dont: Don't chase second kill after pick.
steps.compact: Second Turtle - Pick before Turtle

steps.description: Track enemy carry positions and flank routes. Keep Ult for high-value target or objective steal denial. Outer shields down at 5:00 — picks now = towers.
steps.decision: Catch carry if they check bush alone.
steps.compact: Mid Game - Flank carry, save Ult

steps.description: Set up Lord vision from sides. Catch enemy rotating alone before team commits to Lord. One pick = free Lord.
steps.decision: If no pick, don't start Lord 50/50.
steps.dont: Don't start Lord while enemy jungler alive.
steps.compact: First Lord - Catch rotator, then Lord

steps.description: Shadow teammate with burst damage. Avoid starting fights while follow-up is clearing wave. Your catch is only as good as your follow-up.
steps.decision: Engage only if burst ally is within 2s.
steps.compact: Lord Push - Shadow burst ally

steps.objective: Threaten fog angles, protect if no pick
steps.description: Threaten fog angles around objectives. If no clean pick exists, protect carry instead of forcing one. A forced hook that misses = lost Lord.
checklist: Fall back to peel if no pick
steps.decision: Force only if enemy carry is isolated and your team is grouped.
steps.dont: Don't force a pick when behind.
steps.compact: Mid-Late - Threaten fog, else peel

steps.description: Save suppression/displacement for enemy's most dangerous diver or carry. One late-game pick can decide match. Dire Hit helps finish low-HP target.
steps.decision: Catch = start Lord. Miss = disengage.
steps.dont: Don't Ult early on tank in late game.
steps.compact: Late / Evolved Lord - Save catch for carry

roles.label: Healer Support
roles.playstyle: Sustain + protect. You keep the team alive through poke and burst. Position is everything — you die first if you face-check.

heroes.name: Estes
heroes.note: Ult wins long fights. Stay behind frontline, heal after enemy burst.

heroes.name: Rafaela
heroes.note: Top roam S42 despite 2.2.16a nerf (55% WR). Speed boost helps engage/disengage. Ban/pick priority.

heroes.name: Angela
heroes.note: Ult to save carry or to join dive. Don't possess tank if carry is being dived.

heroes.name: Floryn
heroes.note: Top sustain in S42 (54% WR). Global Ult can save fight from across map. Don't waste on full-HP team.

heroes.name: Marcel
heroes.note: S-tier S42: 57% WR, 40%+ ban. Soul Tether mitigates damage, wide freeze starts fights. If open, first-pick.

roles.emblem: Support Emblem — Focusing Mark. Prioritize Heal Effect + Movement Speed + Hybrid Defense.
strengths: Wins poke wars and long fights
Best at keeping MM alive vs dive
weaknesses: No engage — needs tank/fighter to start
roles.win_condition: Survive first burst, heal team through it, then win the extended fight.
roles.lose_condition: Face-checking, or using Ult/heal before enemy engages.

steps.objective: Stay safe, don't take jungle EXP
steps.description: Buy Roam blessing. Stay near team without taking jungle EXP or exposing yourself to invade. You are the squishiest early.
steps.decision: If invade, retreat and ping — don't trade HP.
steps.compact: Setup - Stay safe, no farm

steps.objective: Sustain mid clear, rotate to pressured lane
steps.description: Help mid sustain first clear, then rotate toward lane most likely to be pressured. Heal after trades, not before.
checklist: Rotate to Gold if MM pressured
steps.decision: Follow strongest nearby teammate.
steps.dont: Don't heal full-HP ally — waste of Favor proc.
steps.compact: Early Rotate - Sustain mid, rotate

steps.objective: Move with ally to Turtle river, keep heal ready
steps.description: Move with ally to Turtle-side river. Keep healing resources for first skirmish. Stay behind tank.
checklist: Be at Turtle river by 1:30 with ally
steps.decision: If team is split, don't go alone.
steps.dont: Don't stand in AoE at pit entrance.
steps.compact: Turtle Setup - Move with ally, save heal

steps.description: Arrive before Turtle. Heal and protect jungler; avoid standing where enemy AoE hits whole team. Spread — don't stack.
checklist: Don't stack with team in pit
steps.decision: Save Ult for enemy engage.
steps.compact: First Turtle - Heal jungler, spread out

steps.description: Follow strongest nearby teammate. Heal after trades and reset safely rather than face-checking. Favor triggers on lowest-HP ally.
steps.decision: If low on heal/Ult, disengage.
steps.compact: Post-Turtle - Follow carry, reset safe

steps.objective: Prep based on real Turtle timer
steps.description: Prepare for next Turtle based on real respawn (~4:00). Keep carry healthy before objective starts. Don't let team start Turtle at half HP.
checklist: Heal team to full before Turtle
steps.decision: If team low, delay Turtle and heal first.
steps.dont: Don't start Turtle while healing on CD.
steps.compact: Second Turtle - Heal full before Turtle

steps.objective: Stay in ability range, save Ult for engage
steps.description: Stay within ability range of frontline and MM. Save major heal/protection for enemy engage. Outer shields down at 5:00 — sustain lets you push towers.
steps.decision: Use Ult when enemy commits, not on poke.
steps.dont: Don't use Ult to heal one poke.
steps.compact: Mid Game - Save Ult for engage

steps.objective: Group before Lord, heal between pokes
steps.description: Group before Lord. Heal between pokes and keep safe position behind frontline. Let tank check bushes.
steps.decision: If team low, reset before Lord.
steps.compact: First Lord - Group, heal between pokes

steps.objective: Escort team, let tank check bushes
steps.description: Escort team through contested areas; let tank check bushes and do not enter dark river first. Heal Lord-push wave.
steps.decision: Push with Lord wave if team healthy.
steps.compact: Lord Push - Let tank check, escort

steps.description: Prioritize teammate who can deal sustained damage. Use Favor's heal trigger on ally who needs it most — usually MM or jungler, not tank.
steps.decision: Peel diver, don't chase.
steps.dont: Don't heal tank while MM dies.
steps.compact: Mid-Late - Heal MM first

steps.objective: Keep core carry alive through first burst
steps.description: Keep core carry alive through first burst. Disengage and regroup if key healing/Ult unavailable. One death = lost Evolved Lord.
checklist: Save Ult for Evolved Lord fight
steps.decision: Fight only if heal/Ult ready.
steps.compact: Late / Evolved Lord - Keep carry alive

roles.label: Utility / Disengage
roles.playstyle: Control + mobility + cleanse. You decide when fights start and when they stop. Save utility for the moment enemy commits.

heroes.name: Diggie
heroes.note: Ult cleanses all CC. Best vs Atlas/Tigreal/Franco comps. Eggs give vision.

heroes.name: Mathilda
heroes.note: Ult + Skill 2 lets ally escape or dive. Strong for Lord picks.

heroes.name: Chip
heroes.note: Portal creates numbers advantage at Turtle/Lord. Don't portal into 1v5.

heroes.name: Carmilla
heroes.note: S-tier S42. Ult links enemies — AoE damage spreads. Great vs grouped comps.

heroes.name: Faramis
heroes.note: Ult revives team in zone. Forces enemy to disengage or fight into revive.

heroes.name: Alice
heroes.note: Flex pick. Needs farm — only if team lacks magic damage.

heroes.name: Nana
heroes.note: Molina stops dives. Situational roam if team needs CC + poke.

heroes.name: Hirara
heroes.note: Primarily jungle/mid in S42. As roam, use for vision/burst — not default blind pick.

heroes.name: Marcel
heroes.note: S-tier S42: 57% WR, 40%+ ban. Wide freeze + Soul Tether. Top utility pick — ban or first-pick.

roles.emblem: Support Emblem — Focusing Mark or Pull Yourself Together (reduces Ult CD). Move Speed + Heal Effect.
strengths: Wins fights by resetting bad fights
weaknesses: Utility wasted if used on poke
roles.win_condition: Use utility when multiple allies benefit — cleanse the engage, shield the carry, portal for numbers.
roles.lose_condition: Spending Ult/cleanse on one low-value target or on harmless poke.

steps.description: Buy Roam blessing. Scout safely and identify whether team needs anti-engage, mobility, or teamfight setup. Don't trade HP early.
steps.decision: If enemy invades, use utility to disengage.
steps.compact: Setup - Scout, pick utility need

steps.objective: Help mid, secure river, save escape
steps.description: Help mid clear and use utility to secure river access. Avoid spending escape/cleanse too early.
steps.decision: Use utility only if ally will die.
steps.compact: Early Rotate - Help mid, save cleanse

steps.objective: Vision with teammate, keep retreat route
steps.description: Rotate toward Turtle and establish vision with teammate. Keep route to retreat — you are not the tank.
checklist: Be at Turtle river by 1:30 with teammate
steps.decision: If enemy collapses, disengage with utility.
steps.compact: Turtle Setup - Vision with teammate

steps.description: Support Turtle contest with shields, cleanse, mobility, or AoE. Disrupt enemy setup rather than diving alone.
steps.decision: Use Ult when enemy commits.
steps.compact: First Turtle - Shield / cleanse on engage

steps.description: Connect lanes and help teammates rotate faster. Use defensive tools when enemy commits, not on harmless poke.
checklist: Use mobility to help ally escape
steps.decision: Rotate to lane with kill chance.
steps.dont: Don't waste utility on one poke.
steps.compact: Post-Turtle - Connect lanes, save utility

steps.description: Track next objective timer and escort jungler through river. Save anti-CC/escape for contest.
steps.decision: If enemy engages, cleanse + disengage.
steps.compact: Second Turtle - Escort jungler, save Ult

steps.objective: Safe paths, deny flanks, split fight
steps.description: Create safe paths for team and deny enemy flanks. Use AoE to split fight. Encourage boosts team damage in grouped fights.
steps.decision: Split fight if enemy groups.
steps.compact: Mid Game - Safe paths, deny flank

steps.description: Prepare Lord-side routes. Use mobility/disengage to reset bad setup instead of forcing 50/50. Portal (Chip) for numbers.
steps.decision: Reset if setup is bad.
steps.compact: First Lord - Prep routes, reset bad fight

steps.description: Stay near teammate most likely to be caught. Reveal approaches and keep utility for counter-engage.
steps.decision: Counter-engage when enemy dives.
steps.dont: Don't use utility to engage alone.
steps.compact: Lord Push - Stay near caught ally

steps.objective: Use utility when multiple allies benefit
steps.description: Use teamfight tools when multiple allies can benefit. Avoid spending major CDs on single low-value target.
steps.decision: Use Ult if 2+ allies benefit.
steps.compact: Mid-Late - Ult for 2+ allies

steps.description: Protect team's formation. Stop dives, help carries reposition, and use Encourage value during grouped fights.
checklist: Save Ult for Evolved Lord fight
steps.decision: Fight only grouped.
steps.compact: Late / Evolved Lord - Protect formation, stop dive

roles.label: Damage / Assassin Roam
roles.playstyle: Burst + vision + picks. You are not a tank — you scout, burst a squishy, and leave. If you die for a support, you lost the trade.

heroes.name: Selena
heroes.note: Traps = vision at Turtle/Lord. Stun + burst deletes MM/mage. Strong early, needs accuracy.

heroes.name: Natalia
heroes.note: Not tagged ROAM in bundled roster — flex pick. Silence + burst vs mage/MM. Don't pick if team has no frontline.

heroes.name: Saber
heroes.note: Flex from Pick-off. Ult one carry, then disengage.

heroes.name: Helcurt
heroes.note: Specialist pick. Ult blinds map for picks. Not default blind pick if team needs frontline.

roles.emblem: Assassin Emblem — Killing Spree or Focusing Mark. Prioritize Adaptive Attack + Move Speed + Penetration.
weaknesses: No frontline — team will be squishy
Falls off if you don't snowball
roles.win_condition: Get early picks, snowball jungler/MM, and end before enemy tank scales.
roles.lose_condition: Trading your life for a support, or diving without exit.

steps.objective: Scout for info, not forced Lv1 fight
steps.description: Buy Roam blessing. Scout for info, not forced Lv1 fight; leave if enemy collapses. Selena: place traps at enemy buff/river.
steps.decision: Leave if enemy collapses 3+.
steps.compact: Setup - Scout, no forced fight

steps.objective: Help mid priority, threaten side angle
steps.description: Help mid secure priority, then threaten side-lane angle. Do NOT steal jungler's camps — your gold is Thriving + picks.
steps.decision: Pick if enemy overextends with no escape.
steps.compact: Early Rotate - Help mid, threaten side

steps.objective: Low-risk pick near Turtle, keep resources for objective
steps.description: Look for low-risk pick near Turtle side. Keep enough resources to contest objective. Traps/vision > kill attempt.
steps.decision: Pick only if you can still contest Turtle.
steps.dont: Don't burn all CDs before Turtle.
steps.compact: Turtle Setup - Low-risk pick, save burst

steps.description: Use traps, marks, or burst to reveal and pressure approaches. Prioritize vision and objective safety over solo kill.
steps.decision: Burst enemy jungler if they step for steal.
steps.compact: First Turtle - Reveal, protect Retri

steps.objective: Fog picks with ally, leave after fail
steps.description: Rotate through fog with ally and punish isolated squishy. Leave after failed attempt — don't stay to be collapsed on.
steps.decision: Pick if ally can follow.
steps.compact: Post-Turtle - Fog pick with ally, leave

steps.description: Time picks around actual Turtle respawn (~4:00). Pressure enemy damage dealer before team starts objective.
steps.decision: Pick = Turtle.
steps.compact: Second Turtle - Pick before Turtle

steps.description: Control side bushes and deny enemy rotations. Avoid trading your life for low-value support — you are the burst.
steps.decision: Burst carry if isolated.
steps.compact: Mid Game - Control bush, save burst

steps.objective: Pick lone checker, don't start Lord split
steps.description: Set up Lord vision and look for pick on enemy who checks alone. Do not start Lord while team is split.
steps.decision: Pick = Lord. No pick = don't start.
steps.compact: First Lord - Pick lone checker, group

steps.objective: Burst to remove vision, keep exit
steps.description: Use burst to remove vision and threaten backline access, but keep exit route after committing. Dire Hit finishes low-HP target.
steps.decision: Dive only with exit.
steps.compact: Lord Push - Burst backline, keep exit

steps.description: Play around enemy defensive CDs. If carry is protected, switch to scouting and objective pressure.
steps.decision: Burst only if defensive CDs down.
steps.compact: Mid-Late - Wait for CDs down

steps.objective: Wait for formation break, finish valid target
steps.description: Wait for enemy formation to break before diving. Dire Hit is for finishing valid target, not replacing team coordination.
steps.decision: Dive only when formation breaks.
steps.compact: Late / Evolved Lord - Wait break, finish target

from_v1_to_v2: Fixed Turtle timing: first Turtle 2:00, respawn ~2 min, stops at 8:00 — original 110-150s window overlapped spawn and missed respawn logic
Fixed Lord timing: first Lord 8:00, Evolved Lord ~18:00 — original said 'Lord becomes available' vaguely at 480-600s without evolve note
Added outer turret shield end at 5:00, Lithowanderer at 0:45, jungler Lv4 window 1:35-1:45
Changed heroes from single string to structured array with archetype + S42 notes; added Marcel (S-tier), Carmilla, Kaja buff, Kalea buff, and clarified flex picks (Natalia, Hirara, Alice, Nana)
Added blessings as structured objects with exact effects, cooldowns, and unlock (1000g Thriving)
Added roam economy: Devotion 30% rule, Thriving 6g+12exp -> 8g+16exp per 5s, stay lowest gold
Added per-step phase, objective, checklist, vision, decision, dont — so table is usable as in-game timer UI
Added solo-queue adaptations: 5-second reveal rule, fake rotation note, don't babysit MM, trade objectives when behind
Added battle spells + emblem per role
